en-US: Collapse duplicate inbox notebooks left by an earlier migration so each workspace keeps one inbox, and desktop sync no longer revives a second empty inbox.
Keep desktop screenshot notes from losing their uploaded image after the staging file is deleted.
Recover same-device memo updates when the server already applied the change but the desktop lost the acknowledgement, instead of showing a false conflict.
zh-CN: 合并历史迁移留下的重复「等待分类」笔记本，每个工作区只保留一个收件箱；桌面同步也不会再把第二个空收件箱拉回来。
桌面端截图笔记在暂存文件被清掉后，会改用已上传的图片地址，不再变成文件名碎片。
同一台电脑上，服务端已经收下笔记但确认丢失时，桌面端会按本机最近保存内容自动对齐，不再误报冲突。
